messages:
Maya Chen: quick UX check — opened the new Alerting side panel in staging. Density feels tight when you have 4+ channels listed, especially on small laptop windows. screenshot: https://…/img/sidepanel-compact.png :thinking_face:
Liam O'Connor: saw that — agree. the list items use 8px vertical padding; bumping to 12px would help readability without blowing up the panel. also aria: when you toggle the preview we currently do aria-live='polite' and it fires twice. should be only once on open.
Sara Patel: suppression labels question: users are confusing "snooze" vs "quiet window" in the preview. I'd vote for "Quiet window (until)" + helper text instead of just "snooze". fewer support tickets.
Alex Rivera: accessibility nit — the channel color badges fail 3:1 on contrast when stacked next to the tiny label. either increase stroke or use a filled pill with accessible label text.
Maya Chen: quick VoiceOver check: when opening preview it announces "Preview" then reads the whole channel list — that's noisy. we want a concise announcement like "Alert preview opened. Summary visible."
Liam O'Connor: proposed code snippet to ensure single announcement:
```
// set live region once on open
liveRegion.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
liveRegion.textContent = 'Alert preview opened.';
// clear after announce to avoid repeats
setTimeout(() => { liveRegion.textContent = ''; }, 1000);
```
This avoids double-fire from re-renders.
Sara Patel: copy tweak idea: change "Notify channels" -> "Notification channels" in the top label, and add a helper tooltip: "Order determines priority when multiple channels match."
Alex Rivera: visual suggestion: collapse low-priority channels under "more channels" with a count badge, keeps main panel short. also add keyboard shortcut focus: `Tab` lands in the preview header, not buried in list.
notify-sim-bot: preview-snapshot generated for thread 1803334444 — result: PASS (contrast check: 2 failures)
Maya Chen: thanks — can someone take the contrast failures + aria-live into a pair of small tickets? I can mock the spacing bump in Figma.
Liam O'Connor: I'll file two tickets: DESIGN-1187 (preview aria-live & VO behavior) and DESIGN-1188 (channel badge contrast + compact spacing). cc @Sara Patel @Alex Rivera :thumbsup:
Sara Patel: :thumbsup: I'll update the copy doc and test quiet window language in our next usability session.
Alex Rivera: I'll prototype collapsed channels interaction and keyboard flow this afternoon.
Maya Chen: perfect — moving to `needs-design` board. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
